description: The capability-type vocabulary's content: the instances the `capabilities` query scope serves. Validates against `capability.schema.json#/$defs/capabilities_payload`, which is the metaschema and holds no instances. Entries map capability distinctions the method library already draws in its primitive tasks; representation.md section 6 records the derivation.

capability_types.label: Locomotion
capability_types.description: Moving the robot itself, or a held payload, from one pose to another. Required by every task that repositions something.

capability_types.label: Gripper
capability_types.description: Grasping and releasing a discrete element — the attach/detach pair. Required by tasks that take custody of an element.

capability_types.label: Lifting
capability_types.description: Bearing and raising an element's weight. Distinct from `gripper`: holding is not lifting, and a robot may offer one without the other.

capability_types.label: Alignment
capability_types.description: Positioning an element to a stated tolerance. Required by tasks whose success is defined by a tolerance rather than by arrival.

capability_types.label: Fastening
capability_types.description: Applying or releasing a mechanical connection at a stated torque.

capability_types.label: Extrusion
capability_types.description: Depositing a continuous material bead at a controlled rate. The additive-manufacturing capability the 3dcp method requires.

capability_types.label: Material handling
capability_types.description: Loading, carrying, and discharging bulk or granular material, as distinct from handling a discrete element (`gripper`). Covers the bucket fill/empty pair and brick transport.

capability_types.label: Mortar application
capability_types.description: Mixing and spreading mortar to a stated thickness.

capability_types.label: Surface treatment
capability_types.description: Applying a coating or a curing treatment to a surface, including humidity maintenance and protective covering.

capability_types.label: Calibration
capability_types.description: Bringing the robot's own instrumentation to a stated precision before productive work begins.
